Name: Iridium Pets
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
I was browsing through the unpacked content files for SDV and I saw these files called 'cat5' and 'dog5' and I was like 'huh those aren't in the game' and well... they aren't(as far as I'm aware from the 4 minutes of research I did.)


But NOW they are! With the use of Alternative Textures you too can have these cuties in your game :] just grab the scissors and bam there you go!

[i]Note: I didn't make the textures, they were just in the game files so I made a mod so people could use them :]


[/i]As always: Thank you to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
